name: UNDYING: REJECT
source:
You were bitten, changed, and left to die. A stranger finds you and offers a choice.

[from [url=https://maneki-mushi.itch.io/undying-reject]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你遭到啃咬、发生异变，随后被弃之等死。一名陌生人找到了你，并在你面前摆出了一个选择。

[摘自[url=https://maneki-mushi.itch.io/undying-reject]itch.io[/url]]
